Definition: to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to strike, smite; 1a) (Qal) to strike, smite; 1b) (Niphal) to be stricken, be smitten; 1c) (Hithpael) to stumble
